summary: Added a `message-interrupted` quiet-state style, fixed a missing `unsent` field in test state, added queued-message tracking to the FakePiSession fixture, wrote tests for undelivered-queue and interrupted-transcript behavior, created a `queue-recovery.ts` module exporting `strandedMessages`, refactored `Composer.svelte` and `composer-actions.ts` to bring them under the line-length cap, and bumped the protocol version from 26 to 27.
decisions: Quiet interrupted turns are styled with `[data-ui='message-interrupted']` as italic muted text rather than an error banner — a stopped turn is a fact about the response, not an error.
`FakePiSession` exposes `queued: string[]`, `pendingMessageCount`, and `clearQueue` so tests can simulate steered messages that were never delivered.
Whitespace-only queued messages are dropped (no `session.unsent` event) rather than restoring an empty composer.
A new `queue-recovery.ts` module owns the `strandedMessages` helper used by `pi-extension-ui-runtime` for recovering undelivered steered text.
Composer responsibilities were moved out into `composer-actions.ts` and `Composer.svelte` was shrunk (294 lines) to satisfy the file-length cap.
Protocol version was bumped from 26 to 27 (commit referenced `protocol v26` changes including per-extension project services).
errors: `pnpm -r check` failed in `@gizmo/app` because `AgentEventState` now requires an `unsent` field that the test's `state()` factory didn't set; resolved by adding `unsent: []` to the factory.

After bumping protocol to 27, `apps/app` tests failed (3 tests) in `PiExtensionUiStore.questions.test.ts` because the fixture hard-codes `protocolVersion: 26`; this was the last action taken and was not yet resolved in the transcript.
